ex.en: I need to charge my cellphone.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

ex.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?
ex.zh: 這附近有可以幫手機充電的地方嗎？

ex.en: First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
ex.zh: 首先，請將手機關機並保持安靜。

ex.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.
ex.zh: 請附上品質證明書。

ex.en: Where's my birth certificate?
ex.zh: 我的出生證明在哪裡？

ex.en: You'll receive a certificate after finishing the course.
ex.zh: 完成課程後你會拿到一張證書。

ex.en: Tom is a celebrity.
ex.zh: 湯姆是名人。

ex.en: You're a celebrity now.
ex.zh: 你現在是名人了。

ex.en: Mary is obsessed with celebrities.
ex.zh: 瑪麗很迷名人。

ex.en: There is a fly on the ceiling.
ex.zh: 天花板上面有隻蒼蠅。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置牢牢固定在天花板上。

ex.en: The ceiling in this room is very high.
ex.zh: 這個房間的天花板很高。

ex.en: The government set a ceiling on rent increases.
ex.zh: 政府對房租漲幅設了上限。

ex.en: There is a price ceiling of 500 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格上限是五百元。

ex.en: This building is LEED Platinum certified.
ex.zh: 這棟建築獲得 LEED 白金級認證。

ex.en: The factory is certified to ISO 9001 standards.
ex.zh: 這座工廠通過 ISO 9001 認證。

ex.en: This document certifies that you completed the course.
ex.zh: 這份文件證明你已完成課程。

ex.en: I am almost 180 centimeters tall.
ex.zh: 我差不多 180 公分高。

ex.en: The average height of the girls in class is over 155 centimeters.
ex.zh: 這班女生的平均身高超過 155 公分。

ex.en: My brother is two years older than I, but he is three centimeters shorter.
ex.zh: 我哥哥比我大兩歲，卻比我矮三公分。

ex.en: I can say with certainty that he hates me.
ex.zh: 我可以肯定地說他討厭我。

ex.en: No one can predict the future with certainty.
ex.zh: 沒有人能確切預測未來。

ex.en: Rain is a certainty in this season.
ex.zh: 這個季節一定會下雨。

ex.en: It's a certainty that prices will rise.
ex.zh: 物價一定會上漲。

ex.en: It has ceased raining.
ex.zh: 雨停了。

ex.en: The company ceased operations last year.
ex.zh: 那家公司去年停止營運。

ex.en: Production will cease at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 生產將在月底停止。

cease.zh: never cease to：總是讓人（驚訝等）

ex.en: His behavior never ceases to surprise me.
ex.zh: 他的所作所為總是讓我驚訝。

ex.en: His memory never ceases to astonish me.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力總是讓我驚嘆。

ex.en: A ceasefire was declared.
ex.zh: 雙方宣布停火。

ex.en: Both sides agreed to a ceasefire.
ex.zh: 雙方同意停火。

ex.en: The company decided to centralize its purchasing.
ex.zh: 公司決定把採購集中管理。

ex.en: All customer data is centralized in one system.
ex.zh: 所有客戶資料都集中在同一個系統裡。

ex.en: According to the latest census, the language's number of speakers appears to be stable, or even increasing.
ex.zh: 根據最新的人口普查，這個語言的使用人數似乎持平，甚至還在增加。

ex.en: The government conducts a census every ten years.
ex.zh: 政府每十年進行一次人口普查。

ex.en: Our school is in the center of the town.
ex.zh: 我們學校在市中心。

ex.en: The library is in the center of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

ex.en: At the city center, there are many tall buildings.
ex.zh: 市中心有很多高樓。

center.zh: （某種活動的）中心、重鎮；中心（機構）

ex.en: Tokyo, as you know, is one of the financial centers of the world.
ex.zh: 如你所知，東京是全球的金融中心之一。

ex.en: The town developed into the center of the economy.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮發展成了經濟中心。

ex.en: The shopping center opens at ten.
ex.zh: 購物中心十點開門。

ex.en: The novel is centered on the Civil War.
ex.zh: 這部小說以南北戰爭為主軸。

ex.en: The discussion centered on the new budget.
ex.zh: 討論的重點集中在新預算上。

ex.en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
ex.zh: 我確信我們會找到解決辦法。

ex.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.
ex.zh: 我不確定他什麼時候會來。

ex.en: It's still not certain who's going to win this match.
ex.zh: 這場比賽誰會贏還不確定。

ex.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
ex.zh: 這間老農舍有一種特別的魅力。

ex.en: I have a certain amount of money on me.
ex.zh: 我身上帶了一些錢。

ex.en: Certain items cannot be returned after purchase.
ex.zh: 某些商品購買後無法退貨。

ex.en: You've worked hard for months and have certainly earned a holiday.
ex.zh: 你辛苦工作了好幾個月，當然該放個假。

ex.en: The weatherman's forecast is almost certainly wrong.
ex.zh: 氣象預報幾乎肯定是錯的。

ex.en: I certainly wouldn't want to be seen with Tom.
ex.zh: 我當然不想被人看到跟湯姆在一起。

ex.en: Certainly. I'll look for it right now.
ex.zh: 當然，我馬上去找。

ex.en: "Can you help me?" "Certainly."
ex.zh: 「你可以幫我嗎？」「當然可以。」

ex.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，腦細胞的效率會變差。

ex.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
ex.zh: 細胞有將食物轉化為能量的能力。

ex.en: Human tissue is made up of cells.
ex.zh: 人體組織是由細胞構成的。

ex.en: I'm going to buy a cell phone tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要去買手機。

ex.en: When I don't have my cell phone, I feel lonely.
ex.zh: 沒有手機的時候我會覺得很寂寞。

ex.en: "Have you seen my cell phone?" "It's on the table."
ex.zh: 「你有看到我的手機嗎？」「在桌上。」

ex.en: Click on the cell and type the number.
ex.zh: 點選儲存格，然後輸入數字。

ex.en: Cell B2 shows the total.
ex.zh: B2 儲存格顯示總數。

ex.en: It costs 25 dollars and 50 cents.
ex.zh: 價錢是二十五元五十分。

ex.en: You gave me only fifty cents.
ex.zh: 你只給了我五十分錢。

ex.en: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
ex.zh: 這些紙箱百分之百可回收。

ex.en: Prices rose by five per cent last year.
ex.zh: 去年物價上漲了百分之五。

ex.en: Is there central heating in this building?
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有中央暖氣系統嗎？

ex.en: Our office is in central Taipei.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在台北市中心。

ex.en: What is the central aim of this plan?
ex.zh: 這個計畫的主要目的是什麼？

ex.en: Customer service is central to our business.
ex.zh: 客戶服務是我們事業的核心。

ex.en: Let's have a good birthday celebration!
ex.zh: 我們來好好慶祝生日吧！

ex.en: I feel a little guilty that I didn't invite him to join the celebration.
ex.zh: 我沒邀請他參加慶祝活動，覺得有點內疚。

ex.en: The company held a celebration for its 20th anniversary.
ex.zh: 公司舉辦了二十週年慶祝活動。

ex.en: The movie was censored before it was shown on TV.
ex.zh: 這部電影在電視播出前被刪剪過。

ex.en: Some words in the song were censored.
ex.zh: 這首歌裡有些字被消音了。

ex.en: The censors cut several scenes from the film.
ex.zh: 審查人員從電影中剪掉了幾個片段。

ex.en: The book had to be approved by a censor.
ex.zh: 這本書必須經過審查員核准。

certified.zh: 經認證的、有執照的、合格的

ex.en: He's a certified cardiologist.
ex.zh: 他是有執照的心臟科醫師。

ex.en: Ziri became a certified online teacher.
ex.zh: 齊莉成為合格的線上教師。

ex.en: This building is LEED Platinum certified.
ex.zh: 這棟建築已獲得 LEED 白金級認證。

ex.en: Please send the contract by certified mail.
ex.zh: 請用掛號寄送合約。

ex.en: I received a certified letter from the bank.
ex.zh: 我收到銀行寄來的掛號信。

ex.en: J.F. Kennedy was buried in Arlington Cemetery.
ex.zh: 約翰甘迺迪被安葬在阿靈頓公墓。

ex.en: The old cemetery is on a hill outside the village.
ex.zh: 那座老公墓位在村子外的山丘上。

ex.en: The film was banned because of government censorship.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為政府審查而被禁。

ex.en: Internet censorship is strict in some countries.
ex.zh: 有些國家的網路審查很嚴格。

ex.en: Kate hardly ever celebrates her birthday.
ex.zh: 凱特幾乎從不慶祝生日。

ex.en: On February 14 Americans celebrate St. Valentine's Day.
ex.zh: 美國人在 2 月 14 日慶祝情人節。

ex.en: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.
ex.zh: 慶祝春節一般叫做「過年」。

ex.en: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.
ex.zh: 奧運開幕典禮已經開始了。

ex.en: The Oscar ceremonies are Hollywood's biggest extravaganza.
ex.zh: 奧斯卡頒獎典禮是好萊塢最盛大的活動。

ex.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
ex.zh: 我不想參加典禮。

ex.en: Much of London was destroyed in the seventeenth century.
ex.zh: 倫敦有很大一部分在十七世紀被毀。

ex.en: 2001 is the year when the 21st century begins.
ex.zh: 2001 年是 21 世紀的開始。

ex.en: The construction straddled two centuries.
ex.zh: 這項工程橫跨了兩個世紀。

ex.en: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.
ex.zh: 您可以跳過認證流程的第三階段，直接進入第六階段。

ex.en: The factory received ISO certification last year.
ex.zh: 這家工廠去年取得了 ISO 認證。

ex.en: The exporter submitted a certificate of origin.
ex.zh: 出口商提交了原產地證明書。

ex.en: A certificate of origin may reduce import duties.
ex.zh: 原產地證明書可能有助於降低進口關稅。

ex.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
ex.zh: 水泥再過幾個小時就會凝固。

ex.en: The contractor ordered more cement for the foundation.
ex.zh: 承包商為地基追加訂購了水泥。
